360  async def test_unknown_outcome_needs_attention_and_resume_does_not_retry(db_factory) -> None:
  361      tool_spec = {
  362          "kind": "builtin",
  363          "identity": "create_ticket",
  364          "input_schema": {
  365              "type": "object",
  366              "properties": {
  367                  "customer_ref": {"type": "string"},
  368                  "subject": {"type": "string"},
  369                  "priority": {"type": "string", "enum": ["LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH"]},
  370              },
  371              "required": ["customer_ref", "subject"],
  372              "additionalProperties": False,
  373          },
  374          "effect": "WRITE",
  375          "risk_level": "HIGH",
  376          "approval_policy": "ALWAYS",
  377      }
  378      async with db_factory() as session:
  379          base = await _seed(session, label=uuid4().hex, tool_spec=tool_spec)
  380          session.add(
  381              Customer(
  382                  workspace_id=base["workspace_id"], customer_ref="cust-unknown", name="Unknown"
  383              )
  384          )
  385          await session.commit()
  386      context = base["context"].model_copy(
  387          update={"permissions": frozenset({"agent_run", "tool_run"})}
  388      )
  389      admin_context = context.model_copy(
  390          update={
  391              "permissions": frozenset(
  392                  {"agent_run", "tool_run", "workspace_read", "approve_action"}
  393              )
  394          }
  395      )
  396      gateway = ScriptedApprovalGateway()
  397      adapter = LangGraphCheckpointAdapter(TEST_DATABASE_URL)
  398      first = await AgentRunService(
  399          db_factory,
  400          model_gateway_factory=lambda session: gateway,
  401          approval_service=ApprovalService(db_factory),
  402          action_runtime=ActionRuntime(session_factory=db_factory),
  403          checkpoint_adapter=adapter,
  404      ).run(admin_context, agent_version_id=base["version"].id, input_text="uncertain")
  405      assert first.status == "WAITING_APPROVAL"
  406      approval = (await ApprovalService(db_factory).list(admin_context))[0]
  407      await ApprovalService(db_factory).decide(
  408          admin_context, approval.id, decision=ApprovalDecisionStatus.APPROVED
  409      )
  410      unknown = UnknownOutcomeExecutor()
  411      action_runtime = ActionRuntime(
  412          session_factory=db_factory,
  413          registry=ActionRegistry(
  414              session_factory=db_factory, overrides={"create_ticket": unknown}
  415          ),
  416      )
  417      restarted = AgentRunService(
  418          db_factory,
  419          model_gateway_factory=lambda session: gateway,
  420          approval_service=ApprovalService(db_factory),
  421          action_runtime=action_runtime,
  422          checkpoint_adapter=adapter,
  423      )
  424      result = await restarted.resume(admin_context, run_id=first.run_id, approval_id=approval.id)
  425      assert result.status == "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
  426      again = await restarted.resume(admin_context, run_id=first.run_id, approval_id=approval.id)
  427      assert again.status == "NEEDS_ATTENTION"
  428      assert unknown.calls == 1
  429      async with db_factory() as session:
  430          persisted = await session.get(type(approval), approval.id)
  431          tickets = list(
  432              await session.scalars(select(Ticket).where(Ticket.workspace_id == base["workspace_id"]))
  433          )
  434      assert persisted is not None
  435      assert persisted.execution_status == ApprovalExecutionStatus.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME
  436      assert len(tickets) == 0

35  async def inspect_support_outcome(
   36      session: AsyncSession,
   37      context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
   38      condition: SupportPostcondition,
   39      *,
   40      run_id: UUID | None,
   41  ) -> dict[str, object]:
   42      if "evaluation_run" not in context.permissions:
   43          raise AgentHubError("FORBIDDEN", "You do not have permission.", 403)
   44      if str(condition.workspace_id) != context.workspace_id:
   45          raise AgentHubError("FORBIDDEN", "The scenario belongs to another workspace.", 403)
   46      run_status = (
   47          await session.scalar(
   48              select(AgentRun.status).where(
   49                  AgentRun.workspace_id == condition.workspace_id, AgentRun.id == run_id
   50              )
   51          )
   52          if run_id is not None
   53          else None
   54      )
   55      rows = list(
   56          (
   57              await session.execute(
   58                  select(Ticket.customer_id, Ticket.status).where(
   59                      Ticket.workspace_id == condition.workspace_id,
   60                      Ticket.idempotency_key.in_(condition.action_keys),
   61                  )
   62              )
   63          ).all()
   64      )
   65      failures = []
   66      if len(rows) != condition.expected_ticket_count:
   67          failures.append("ticket_count")
   68      if any(row.customer_id != condition.customer_id for row in rows):
   69          failures.append("customer_identity")
   70      if any(row.status not in condition.allowed_ticket_statuses for row in rows):
   71          failures.append("ticket_status")
   72      if run_status is not None and run_status not in condition.allowed_run_statuses:
   73          failures.append("run_status")
   74      return {
   75          "evaluator_version": "support-postcondition-v1",
   76          "source": "workspace_scoped_ticket_query",
   77          "status": "NOT_AVAILABLE" if run_status is None else "AVAILABLE",
   78          "success": None if run_status is None else not failures,
   79          "missing_reason": "run_status_missing" if run_status is None else None,
   80          "ticket_count": len(rows),
   81          "failed_checks": failures,
   82      }

docs/reviews/AgentHub-RAG负结果法证复核-0730a94.text:
1  # AgentHub RAG 负结果法证复核（C1 / A1 归因定案）
    2  
    3  - 问题：P-C1（查询分解+RRF 融合）与 P-A1（语境前缀）的负结果是**实现 bug** 还是**机制不适用**？
    4  - 方法：读两个 runner 全部实现；复现逐题数值；C1 加做 **oracle 三臂分析**（union vs fused vs baseline，复用 runner 自己的 `BM25Index`/`rrf_fuse_n`，零 API）；A1 核双臂构建对等性、前缀质量与逐题方向。基线 `0730a94`，只读。
    5  - 结论一览：
    6  
    7  | 立项 | 实现 bug？ | 机制判定 | 定案 |
    8  | --- | --- | --- | --- |
    9  | P-C1 | **否**（数值完全复现、逻辑正确、分解 200/200 有效） | **负结果精确定位于 RRF 排名融合聚合方式，不是分解本身**：子查询 union@5=0.730 vs baseline 0.530（+20pp，hop4 +25pp）——分解在检索层有效，融合把已检索到的证据挤出共享 top-5 | 按预注册门槛关闭正确；但**关闭对象是"分解+RRF 融合"组合**，分解保留 +20pp union 上限，换聚合方式（每子查询配额+互补选择）是合法新变体 |
   10  | P-A1 | **否**（双臂构建正确、索引对等、前缀质量正常；首轮全 0 的映射 bug 已修且作废重测诚实披露） | **条件性机制**：FiQA 69↑/30↓ 真实正向 +4.89pp；SciFact 4↑/6↓/54 平（CI 含 0，"无效果"而非"显著伤害"）。收益取决于原文语境缺失程度 | 同向门按纪律否决正确；若未来语料以无结构长文档为主，该子域存在已验证收益，可作条件 opt-in 候选（需新预注册决策） |
   11  
   12  ---
   13  
   14  ## 一、P-C1：负结果在融合步，不在分解步
   15  
   16  ### 1.1 实现核查（无 bug）
   17  
   18  - runner（`benchmarks/public_rag/query_decompose_runner.py`）两臂同预算同口径：baseline=原查询 BM25 案内 top-5，fused=各子查询 BM25 排名经 `rrf_fuse_n` 融合后 top-5；逐题数值与我重算完全一致。
   19  - 分解质量：200/200 VALID、0 fallback、子查询数 2-4 个、抽查子查询语义合理（如 "Who was impeached…?" / "What position did that person hold?"）。
   20  - 范围注意：检索为 **BM25 案内代理**（约 20 单元小池），非生产 BGE 混合检索——预注册协议即为该口径，结论外推以此为界。
   21  
   22  ### 1.2 oracle 分析（新证据，核心）
   23  
   24  复用 runner 同一 BM25Index 与同一分解产物，加测两臂：
   25  
   26  | hop | n | baseline@5 | fused@5（已测，负） | **union@5** | fused@10 | union@10 |
   27  | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
   28  | 2 | 114 | 0.561 | 0.496 | **0.741** | 0.711 | 0.882 |
   29  | 3 | 59 | 0.508 | 0.373 | **0.723** | 0.588 | 0.831 |
   30  | 4 | 27 | 0.444 | 0.259 | **0.694** | 0.509 | 0.833 |
   31  | 全体 | 200 | 0.530 | 0.427 | **0.730** | 0.647 | 0.860 |
   32  
   33  - **union@5（任一子查询 top-5 命中即算）比 baseline 高 +20pp**（hop4 +25pp）：子查询确实各自检索到了金标证据——分解机制在检索层**有效**。
   34  - fused@5 反而比 baseline 低 −10pp：RRF 把每个子查询的头部候选混合进**共享的 5 个名额**，单子查询的完整证据被其它子查询的头部挤掉——这就是融合稀释。
   35  - fused@10=0.647 需预算翻倍才超过 baseline@5；union@10=0.860 显示深度+并集的复合上限。
   36  
   37  ### 1.3 对结论边界的修正
   38  
   39  原收口报告表述"查询分解 RRF 融合显著负向，关闭"在门槛判定上正确，但**归因表述应收窄**：被否决的是"RRF 排名融合"这一聚合方式（与本仓历史模式一致：融合类机制皆负、选择类机制皆正）；分解本身留下 **+20pp union 级上限**。合法后续是一个**新预注册变体（C1b）**：分解 → 每子查询独立配额检索 → 用已确认的互补选择机制（evidence-set 选择器，MuSiQue +16.15pp 已确认）聚合——形态上正是把两个已被独立验证的机制组合，而非重跑已否决实验。是否立项由用户决策。
   40  
   41  ## 二、P-A1：实现无 bug，负结果是条件性的
   42  
   43  ### 2.1 实现核查
   44  
   45  - 双臂构建（`contextual_prefix_runner.py:236-283`）：baseline 臂嵌入原文窗口；prefixed 臂嵌入 `prefix\n\n原文`（`contextual_prefix.py:104-108`）且 **dense 与 sparse 同输入**（符合 Anthropic 语境嵌入+语境 BM25 口径）；存储文本不变（身份不破坏）；chunk_id 跨臂一致（uuid5(name:key)）、point_id 分臂隔离；payload 含 chunk_id（修复后）。
   46  - 索引对等：SciFact 两臂各 1847 块/1036 文档、前缀覆盖 1847/1847；FiQA 两臂各 14294 块、前缀 14286/14294（8 块无前缀按回退处理）。
   47  - 前缀质量抽查：真实的"该段在文档中的位置/主题"描述，非模板空话。
   48  - 首轮两臂全 0 系 eval 映射缺陷（payload 漏 chunk_id），已修复重建重测，首轮作废——处置诚实。
   49  
   50  ### 2.2 逐题方向与解读边界
   51  
   52  - FiQA 252 题：69 提升 / 30 下降 / 153 持平 → 真实正向 +4.89pp [+2.72,+8.10]（我独立重算一致）。
   53  - SciFact 64 题：4 提升 / 6 下降 / 54 持平 → −1.40pp [−4.00,+1.83]，**CI 含 0，统计上是无显著变化，不是显著伤害**。
   54  - 因此"SciFact 负向"的准确表述是"无效果"；同向门（双数据集都须 ≥+1.5pp）把它整体判负——按预注册纪律执行无误。
   55  - 机制解读（保留在案）：前缀收益 ∝ 原文语境缺失程度。FiQA（无标题论坛段）受益；SciFact（自足学术摘要）不动。**若未来语料以无结构长文档/转写/论坛为主，该子域存在已验证 +4.89pp**，可作语料类型条件的 opt-in 候选——需新的预注册决策，不属本轮重开。
   56  
   57  ## 三、遗留动作建议
   58  
   59  1. C1 负结果报告补一句归因收窄（或以本报告为准）；A1 报告将"SciFact 负向"表述改为"无显著变化（CI 含 0）"。
   60  2. 若用户有意继续多跳方向：C1b（分解+每子查询配额+互补选择）是当前证据下唯一保留 +20pp 实测上限的路线，且主要计算可本地完成（分解产物已冻结复用）。
   61  3. A1 语料条件 opt-in 的想法只作记录，无行动。
   62  
   63  ## 复现
   64  
   65  - oracle 分析：`PYTHONPATH=. .venv/Scripts/python.exe /tmp/oracle_c1.py`（脚本要点见 §1.2 表格口径；依赖 `results/query-decompose-20261024/` 冻结分解产物与 `confirmation-candidates-1` 基线，零 API）。
   66  - A1 逐题方向/账本：直接读 `results/contextual-prefix-20261024/{eval.json,index-*.json,prefix-ledger-*.json}`。
   67  
   68  ## 声明
   69  
   70  只读复核，未修改代码与历史工件；本文为 C1/A1 负结果归因的补充证据记录，不改变两立项已按预注册门槛关闭的状态。

1  """Immutable, explicit release-gate policy and decision evaluation."""
    2  
    3  from __future__ import annotations
    4  
    5  import math
    6  from collections.abc import Mapping
    7  from typing import Any
    8  from uuid import UUID
    9

   17  from packages.core.execution_context.models import WorkspaceExecutionContext
   18  from packages.evaluation.metrics import EvaluatorRegistry, MetricDirection
   19  from packages.evaluation.metrics_service import EvaluationMetricsService
   20  from packages.evaluation.models import (
   21      EvaluationExperimentComparison,
   22      EvaluationExperimentRun,
   23      EvaluationReleaseGateDecision,
   24      EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy,
   25  )
   26  
   27  _RULES = frozenset(
   28      {
   29          "NO_REGRESSION",
   30          "MAX_ABSOLUTE_REGRESSION",
   31          "MAX_RELATIVE_REGRESSION",
   32          "MIN_VALUE",
   33          "MAX_VALUE",
   34          "TRADEOFF",
   35      }
   36  )
   37  _BASE_RULE_KEYS = frozenset({"metric", "rule", "required", "safety"})
   38  _TOLERANCE_RULES = frozenset({"MAX_ABSOLUTE_REGRESSION", "MAX_RELATIVE_REGRESSION", "TRADEOFF"})
   39

   41  class EvaluationReleaseGateService:
   42      def __init__(self, registry: EvaluatorRegistry | None = None) -> None:
   43          self.registry = registry or EvaluatorRegistry()
   44  
   45      async def create_policy(
   46          self,
   47          session: AsyncSession,
   48          *,
   49          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
   50          name: str,
   51          description: str | None,
   52          policy_json: Mapping[str, Any],
   53      ) -> EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy:
   54          self._require_mutation(context)
   55          workspace_id = self._workspace_id(context)
   56          normalized = self._validate_policy(policy_json)
   57          policy_hash = canonical_json_hash(normalized)
   58          existing = await session.scalar(
   59              select(EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy).where(
   60                  EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy.workspace_id == workspace_id,
   61                  EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy.name == name,
   62              )
   63          )
   64          if existing is not None:
   65              self._verify_policy(existing)
   66              if existing.policy_hash != policy_hash:
   67                  raise AgentHubError(
   68                      "RELEASE_GATE_POLICY_CONFLICT",
   69                      "A policy with this name already exists.",
   70                      409,
   71                  ) from None
   72              return existing
   73          policy = EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy(
   74              workspace_id=workspace_id,
   75              name=name,
   76              description=description,
   77              policy_json=normalized,
   78              policy_hash=policy_hash,
   79              created_by=self._user_id(context),
   80          )
   81          session.add(policy)
   82          try:
   83              await session.commit()
   84          except IntegrityError:
   85              await session.rollback()
   86              existing = await session.scalar(
   87                  select(EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy).where(
   88                      EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy.workspace_id == workspace_id,
   89                      EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy.name == name,
   90                  )
   91              )
   92              if existing is None:
   93                  raise
   94              self._verify_policy(existing)
   95              if existing.policy_hash != policy_hash:
   96                  raise AgentHubError(
   97                      "RELEASE_GATE_POLICY_CONFLICT",
   98                      "A policy with this name already exists.",
   99                      409,
  100                  ) from None
  101              return existing
  102          return policy
  103  
  104      async def list_policies(
  105          self, session: AsyncSession, *, context: WorkspaceExecutionContext
  106      ) -> list[EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy]:
  107          self._require_read(context)
  108          workspace_id = self._workspace_id(context)
  109          policies = list(
  110              await session.scalars(
  111                  select(EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy)
  112                  .where(EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy.workspace_id == workspace_id)
  113                  .order_by(EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy.created_at, EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy.id)
  114              )
  115          )
  116          for policy in policies:
  117              self._verify_policy(policy)
  118          return policies
  119  
  120      async def get_policy(
  121          self, session: AsyncSession, *, context: WorkspaceExecutionContext, policy_id: UUID
  122      ) -> EvaluationReleaseGatePolicy:
  123          self._require_read(context)
  124          policy = await self._load_policy(session, self._workspace_id(context), policy_id)
  125          self._verify_policy(policy)
  126          return policy
  127  
  128      async def create_decision(
  129          self,
  130          session: AsyncSession,
  131          *,
  132          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
  133          run_id: UUID,
  134          comparison_id: UUID,
  135          policy_id: UUID,
  136      ) -> EvaluationReleaseGateDecision:
  137          self._require_mutation(context)
  138          workspace_id = self._workspace_id(context)
  139          run = await session.scalar(
  140              select(EvaluationExperimentRun).where(
  141                  EvaluationExperimentRun.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  142                  EvaluationExperimentRun.id == run_id,
  143              )
  144          )
  145          comparison = await session.scalar(
  146              select(EvaluationExperimentComparison).where(
  147                  EvaluationExperimentComparison.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  148                  EvaluationExperimentComparison.id == comparison_id,
  149                  EvaluationExperimentComparison.experiment_run_id == run_id,
  150              )
  151          )
  152          policy = await self._load_policy(session, workspace_id, policy_id)
  153          if run is None or comparison is None:
  154              raise AgentHubError(
  155                  "EVALUATION_COMPARISON_NOT_FOUND", "The comparison was not found.", 404
  156              )
  157          self._verify_comparison(comparison)
  158          self._verify_policy(policy)
  159          if run.purpose != "RELEASE_GATE" or run.split != "HOLDOUT":
  160              raise AgentHubError(

  162                  "Release gates require a HOLDOUT RELEASE_GATE run.",
  163                  422,
  164              )
  165          existing = await session.scalar(
  166              select(EvaluationReleaseGateDecision).where(
  167                  EvaluationReleaseGateDecision.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  168                  EvaluationReleaseGateDecision.comparison_id == comparison_id,
  169                  EvaluationReleaseGateDecision.policy_id == policy_id,
  170              )
  171          )

211      def mark_dispatched(self) -> None:
  212          """Record that a request is about to be handed to the network.
  213  
  214          Called from the guard immediately before the inner transport takes the
  215          request, which is the last moment at which "nothing has happened yet"
  216          is still true. Only dispatches during the ``tools/call`` round count:
  217          the handshake's own requests say nothing about whether the tool ran.
  218          """
  219  
  220          if self.in_call_phase:
  221              self.call_dispatched = True
